subject: SOC2 scoping: multi-tenant log access, SFTP & evidence protocol
messages:
From: Eva Thomas <eva.thomas@orionlane.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: security@orionlane.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 scoping: log access & transfer protocol

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As we start the SOC 2 scoping for Orion Lane (multi-tenant SaaS), we need to align on how Redwood delivers log artifacts and whether there are options for an SFTP-style transfer window or presigned S3 links. Key questions from our security team: 

- Can you confirm how you partition telemetry/logs per tenant and whether we can obtain tenant-specific exports?
- Do you support temporary SFTP drop boxes or time-limited presigned URLs for bulk log pulls?
- Minimum retention windows you can demonstrate (sample logs requested for 7/1–7/14).
- We also need any CAIQ/SIG mapping you have for data flow and storage to prep our questionnaire.

Can we book a 30–45 minute working call next week to go over scope and artifact transfer options? Recording is fine if Redwood needs it.

Attendees on our side will be: myself, Raj Patel (engineering), and our security lead (copied).

Thanks —
Eva Thomas
Senior InfoSec Manager
Orion Lane

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Eva Thomas <eva.thomas@orionlane.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 scoping: log access & transfer protocol

Eva —

Appreciate the detail. We can absolutely run through this on a working call. High level: Redwood can provide tenant-scoped log exports (we keep tenant IDs in the telemetry layer and can slice by tenant), and we support both presigned S3 URLs and temporary SFTP drops depending on customer preference and compliance needs. Retention demo/sample windows are configurable — 14 days is straightforward for a sample pull.

Proposed times (PST) next week: Tue 2027-08-24 09:00–09:45, Wed 2027-08-25 10:00–10:45, or Thu 2027-08-26 14:00–14:45. Which works for you?

Prep notes for the call (if you can share before):
- Exact date range and number of tenants you want samples for
- Whether you prefer SFTP vs presigned S3 for transfer
- Any IP allowlist constraints for inbound pulls
- CAIQ/SIG items you particularly want to review (we maintain a mapping doc)

Looping in Marissa (security & compliance) to own the artifact handoff and upload protocol. I attached a quick intake form and will follow up with our scope matrix and log sample spec.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
attachments: security-intake-quickform.pdf (form)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Eva Thomas <eva.thomas@orionlane.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 scoping: log access & transfer protocol

Hi Eva —

Thanks for scheduling, Ben. Confirming Wed 2027-08-25 at 10:00–10:45 PST for the working session. Calendar invite sent separately.

Action owners and what I'll bring to the call: 
- Marissa Cole (me): evidence handoff playbook, SFTP options, presigned URL lifecycle, and CAIQ mapping. I'll share the scope matrix and log sample spec ahead of the call (attached).
- Ben Carter: contract/PO redlines and commercial context if we talk about committed transfer windows.

Pre-call asks (please share if available):
- Exact tenant IDs or sample account IDs to slice logs (we can also provide anonymized samples if you prefer).
- Network allowlist IPs for presigned pulls or SFTP ingress.
- Any auditors/third parties who will need access.

What we can provide during the call/demo:
- A walkthrough of the telemetry pipeline showing tenant scoping and masking rules.
- Live demonstration of generating a presigned S3 URL and the expiry lifecycle.
- Template SFTP workflow (credentials, rotation cadence, one-time users).
- Sample log bundle for 2027-07-01 to 2027-07-14 (redacted PII), size estimate ~2.1 GB compressed per tenant.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-scope-matrix.xlsx, log-sample-spec.md.

Related links: HubSpot deal ORION-54321 (linked).

If you need us to route artifacts to a gated secure transfer (Box/ShareFile) instead, let us know and we'll include that in the runbook.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-soc2-scope-matrix.xlsx, log-sample-spec.md

From: Eva Thomas <eva.thomas@orionlane.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 scoping: log access & transfer protocol — confirmed

Thanks Ben and Marissa —

Confirmed for 10:00 PST today. A couple of quick notes before the call:

- We will need the sample bundle to include request_id, tenant_id, timestamp, and any event-type fields — the log-sample-spec looks good as a template.
- For transfer: we prefer presigned S3 links over SFTP if possible; we will provide IP allowlist ranges in the call.
- Recording consent: yes, you may record for internal runbook use. Please avoid sharing PII in the recording.

Attendees from Orion Lane: Eva Thomas (InfoSec), Raj Patel (Eng), Sonya Lim (Security Ops).

Also, Raj asked whether Redwood can rotate a short-lived key and provide the rotation schedule in the runbook — Marissa, can you bring the key rotation policy?

Appreciate it — see you on the call.

—Eva
